routines.prompt_at_read: Routine: keep OpenSpineConsortium/beethoven (the project hub) current. greg chose "Push to main" (card, 2026-10-05 00:13Z): once PR #1 is merged, syncs go straight to main with no pull request; until it is merged they go to the branch claude/handoff-state-file-m0rg4r and update PR #1. In /home/user/beethoven: check whether PR #1 is merged; if it is, fetch and check out main (fast-forward only) before syncing; then, from a clean tree, run python3 tools/sync.py --push with the commit trailers. Only sync commits go to main this way; changes to the hub's own files (README, tools, REPOS, SEAMS, HISTORY) still go through a pull request. Refresh linear/ISSUES.md and linear/issues.json only if the last refresh is more than a day old and Linear answers. Report CONFLICT lines to greg in the thread; if nothing changed and nothing needs him, end the turn without a reply. Keep it light: greg is near his weekly limit.
